reconstruction_notes: Original whole-organism stylized living reconstruction, not specimen-exact restoration; skull evidence anchor IVPP V4063 with corroboration from separately identified individuals.
Soft tissues, muted colors, body proportions, feet, membrane contour/ankleward attachment, and low glide pose are artistic generalized completion.
Rounded posterior crushing crowns are simplified proxies, with no exact lower tooth-count assertion. Jaw tips remain toothless and upturned.
Thin opaque membranes are closed 3 mm shells with intentional thickness; all surfaces palette-only.
Faceted flat normals throughout; flying root is torso center; lowest point below zero is intentional.
Research READY is not independent quality acceptance; formal GPU and composed scene tests NOT_RUN.
